Job Summary

Maintain, monitor and review daily operation and facilities to ensure employee safety comply with safety, health and environmental regulations for specified facilities, operations and project

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Prepare and present SHE training and SHE induction to enhance safety awareness among Head Office employees.
Safety awareness among Head Office employees is significantly enhanced.

Conduct inspections on statutory, fire and rescue equipment to ensure completeness and readiness for use.
Statutory, fire, and rescue equipment are complete and ready to use.

Inspects project facilities, equipments, observe operations and activities in progress to ensure those are in compliance with company's safety regulations.
project facilities, equipments, observe operations and activities in progress are in compliance with company's safety regulations.

Support and assist safety audits, inspections and accident/incident investigations by observing employee activities and workplace conditions for submitting recommendations to management to correct deficiencies, eliminate hazards, and improve the overall program.
The overall program is significantly improved.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

Education

Diploma Degree of Any Major

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 2 years experiences in Environmental or fresh graduate

• Willing to work outside of office hour
• Good communication and presentation skill
• Willing to travel to all company’s sites

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)

wo-jpfa-JR3325.d:
Melaksanakan kegiatan operasional transportasi harian, termasuk mengemudi, mengoperasikan kendaraan, dan melakukan pengiriman. Memastikan pengangkutan personel, barang, atau material berlangsung dengan aman, tepat waktu, dan efisien. Melakukan pemeriksaan dasar kendaraan serta melaporkan masalah mekanis atau aspek keselamatan. Mematuhi peraturan lalu lintas, standar keselamatan, dan prosedur perusahaan. Mengelola catatan perjalanan, dokumen pengiriman, dan data kendaraan. Mendukung kegiatan dasar pemuatan, pembongkaran, dan pelaksanaan rute perjalanan.

Kualifikasi:

• Pria.
• Min. SMA atau sederajat.
• Memiliki SIM B1 yang masih berlaku.
• Bisa menggunakan telepon genggam android.
• Memiliki pengalaman mengemudi kendaraan komersial, diutamakan yang berpengalaman mengangkut ternak atau muatan yang memerlukan penanganan khusus.
• Mampu melakukan tugas fisik seperti mengangkat, memuat, dan membongkar muatan.
• Memahami dengan baik prinsip-prinsip kesejahteraan hewan dan praktik penanganan yang aman untuk anak ayam hidup.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang sangat baik.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
• Bersedia bekerja dengan jam kerja fleksibel, termasuk pagi hari, malam hari, dan akhir pekan, sesuai kebutuhan.
• Mengetahui kondisi jalan dan rute pengiriman di wilayah setempat.
